title: Shared definitions
description: Enums and small shapes reused by every other schema. Changing an enum here changes it everywhere.

key.description: Stable slug. Never reused, never renamed once published.

section.description: A enacted state laws; B state bills; B.2 state catastrophic-risk bills; C auditor/verifier licensing; D federal bills; E federal drafts; F adjacent federal bills; G executive actions; G.2 litigation; G.3 export controls; H precursors; I adjacent provisions; J excluded.

status.description: What the entry is today. Set by rule from the source record, never guessed from prose.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter state code, US, or Federal. Null only for excluded (section J) items.

stateCode.description: The state tile this entry belongs on. Null for federal and excluded items. Replaces the hardcoded state overrides in the UI.

eventType.description: The eight event types the timeline uses. The UI folds them into six display kinds.

confidenceBasis.description: Why the level was given. primary_record: read from an official API or the bill text. corroborated: two or more reputable secondary sources. search_negative: a dated 'none located'. Automated entries may only use primary_record, corroborated, secondary or single_source.

evidence.description: A verbatim passage from a fetched source that supports one field. The validator checks, in code, that the quote appears word for word in the stored source text.

field.description: Dotted path of the field supported, e.g. mechanism, thresholds, events[2].

origin.description: authored: written by the tracker's author. automated: produced and verified by the agents. mixed: authored entry later updated by the agents.

rounds.description: Generator/validator rounds it took to pass.
